tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground of every figure and page. Figures paint it as their own background so they read on any host page.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Code blocks, the mailbox band in sequences, the fill behind waiting hatch. Never a card fill for emphasis.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, separators between panels, tracks, guides. Structure only (1.37:1 light, 1.67:1 dark); never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: The 45° lines of the waiting hatch, over wash. Always paired with a legend entry or a label.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, axis labels, tick values, replies. On paper, wash, accent-wash and signal-wash (≥5.4:1 light, ≥6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, headings, math, the shared parameters Θ before an update, the close() mark. On every ground in both themes (≥15:1 light, ≥11.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Petrol. Shared state only: Θ after a commit, exchanges, the syncer, commits, the elected learner, merge arrows. Text on paper, wash and accent-wash (≥6.2:1 light, ≥6.4:1 dark). Never a learner.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of the elected learner's card and of syncer notes, under accent text and an accent border.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and digits on an accent fill (7.25:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Oxblood. What is lost: dropped or overwritten steps, rejected snapshots, a timeout that gives up. Text on paper and signal-wash (≥7.7:1 light, ≥5.2:1 dark). Never decoration.

tokens.name: signal-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind the signal hatch of lost work, with a signal outline.

tokens.name: learner-a
tokens.usage: Identity of learner or node A (slate). Fills and lifelines; 5.5:1 on paper light, 6.8:1 dark. Never for meaning.

tokens.name: learner-b
tokens.usage: Identity of learner or node B (ochre). Fills and lifelines; 3.3:1 on paper light, 8.7:1 dark: never set text in it.

tokens.name: learner-c
tokens.usage: Identity of learner or node C (sage). Fills and lifelines; 4.3:1 on paper light, 7.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: learner-d
tokens.usage: Identity of learner or node D (mauve). Fills and lifelines; 6.1:1 on paper light, 6.3:1 dark.

families.sans: "Source Sans 3", "Source Sans Pro", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name on a cover or a page masthead. Once per page.

styles.name: math
styles.usage: Variables and equations in figures and pages: Θ, θᵢ, Δ, η, β, m, H. Italic letters, upright digits and operators. Source Serif 4, since Newsreader has no Greek; Noto Sans Math supplies ∇.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each worker runs an inner optimizer for H steps before it takes part in a shared update.
styles.usage: Running text, about 65 characters a line.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions and notes under a figure.

styles.name: figure-title
styles.usage: Panel and row titles inside a figure.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels inside figures: lanes, arrows, legends. A 960px figure shows at about 0.9× on GitHub.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Tick values, subtitles and secondary labels inside figures. Never below 11px.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, API names, object keys (units/000003-1), in pages and figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Swatch to label, a tick's length.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Minimum clearance between a label and any mark or line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of a legend, between a title and its subtitle block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Figure margin: nothing drawn closer than this to a figure's edge; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page padding, gap between major figure blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, notes, code blocks, the figure ground.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Timeline marks (steps, waiting, exchange): half the mark height, so a mark is a pill.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills in HTML: round chips, legend swatches, round markers.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Borders, separators, axes, ticks, contour lines.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Arrows, card outlines, dashed replies, the syncer's lifeline.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: The one path a figure is about (a descent step, a merged vector) and learner lifelines.

figure.note: Fixed sizes for figures exported as SVG.

tokens.name: figure-width
tokens.usage: Width of every figure's viewBox; heights vary.

tokens.name: mark-height
tokens.usage: Height of a timeline mark.

tokens.name: lane-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between the tops of two lanes: a mark plus 6px.

tokens.name: arrow-head
tokens.usage: Size of a filled arrowhead, the same on every arrow whatever its stroke.
